data: Amazon is far larger by total assets. For fiscal 2025, which ended December 31, 2025, Amazon reported total assets of roughly $818 billion, up from about $624.9 billion at the end of fiscal 2024. I am less certain of this year-end figure than of NVIDIA's, so please check it against Amazon's 2025 Form 10-K. NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 ended January 26, 2025, and it reported total assets of about $111.6 billion, up from $65.7 billion a year earlier. Using those figures, Amazon's asset base is about 7.3 times NVIDIA's. The two fiscal years end almost a year apart, so this is not a point-in-time comparison. NVIDIA's balance sheet has grown quickly since then, so a calendar-aligned comparison would show a smaller ratio. Amazon's lead mainly reflects its large holdings of property and equipment, such as data centers and fulfillment facilities, while NVIDIA's assets are concentrated in cash, marketable securities, receivables and inventory.
